QuestInfo.name: [Karote] A Hidden Mural
QuestInfo.0: After witnessing the #bmemory#k, you returned to the tower.
QuestInfo.2:
You told #bNeinheart#k about the memory you witnessed.
He seems to have something to think about.
For now, try to climb the restored tower.
QuestInfo.1:
The tower is swiftly rising up again.
#bNicky#k is surprised, saying it's never happened before.
The Alliance members are glad to see you back safely.
Tell #bNeinheart#k what you've seen.
